text_block_list.text: —One day during summer training camp.
That day, Symboli Kris S and I were solemnly going through our hard training, but—

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"—I've been a huge fan since the Takarazuka Kinen!
Good luck in your next race!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
—Tap Dance City, do your best—!!
We're really looking forward to the Kyoto Daishoten—!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
I'm gonna show you the ultimate "romance"!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fans
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaahhh!!!)

...It seems the cheering is coming from
Tap Dance City's fans, who had come
to watch the public training session.

Ever since the Takarazuka Kinen, the number of fans
who had fallen under Tap Dance City's spell
had clearly increased.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: ...Kris S?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—My apologies.
...I will start... the next set right away.
Just then, seeing the way she looked, an intuition struck me.

"Could it be that whatever Symboli Kris S is carrying
is connected to Tap Dance City's
wild passion...?"
choice_data_list: (I really need to set aside some time for us to talk.)

text_block_list.text:
Determined to move things forward,
I decided to make a plan so I could have a proper, unhurried talk with Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Today is... a day off?
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day-long cooldown.

text_block_list.text: “I'm not lying. I've been enduring a relentless schedule preparing for the Tenno Sho (Autumn), so it is true that I'd like to take a break and refresh myself.”
However, this time... I decided to use that opportunity to have a dialogue with her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
âIndeed, right now...
is the perfect timeâto sort things out.
choice_data_list: I know a nice cool spot, let's go there!

text_block_list.text: Together with Symboli Kris S, I came to a mountain stream not far from the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...This is a nice place.
choice_data_list: It's really calming, isn't it?
It really calms you down, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry for taking up your time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...You gave me—
time—to speak, didn't you?
choice_data_list: ...So you figured it out.
...Ah, so you found out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Because while they're the same—they're also different.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...—I was thinking... about "heat."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Throughout all the days leading up to today—
I have been called—'cold.'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That's—something I'm... aware of, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...All that resides within me—
is the single resolve—to fulfill my 'mission.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The 'heat' everyone talks about...
...Something to... reach that frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's... nowhere to be found.
I don't even know... what it looks like.
...And yet—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"And so... I thought it didn't matter.
I thought... it wasn't necessary, either—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Because I thought that—
as long as I stacked up "results"—
I could achieve a "revolution."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Running alongside... Gimlet...
and Tap...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Seeing up close... their own—immeasurable heat—
and the frenzy... that they brought about...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I lost sight of it...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Even if I... pile up "results"—I cannot—create true fervor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yet—Gimlet and the others... can create craze—
surpass their limits—and surely,
change the world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I can't help but realize... that I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: On the other hand... without that "passion," could someone like me ever... change the world...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps achieving this "revolution"...—
is impossible after all...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I overthought it... and then—
I just stopped... understanding anything...
choice_data_list: —What's so wrong with having no "heat"?
—What's so wrong with having no "heat"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: ...What's so wrong with being cold?
...What's so wrong with being cold?

text_block_list.text:
...The worry Symboli Kris S wrung from her heart
and shared with me.
A distrust of her own lack of passion—
My answer to that was—
What I should say as a Trainer is—

The hint had been there all along,
within the journey shared with Symboli Kris Sâ

Surely, this isn't something that can just be said—
it must be shown to her in a tangible form.
And for that—
choice_data_list: Could you come with me for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.
Returning with Symboli Kris S to the beach used for summer camp training, the very person we were looking for was right there—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That's—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Th-Thank you so much for running alongside me...!
Tap-san...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whew~! No need for thanks.
It's great motivation for me too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, though—
Even while running in the Classic Class,
it's painfully obvious who you're fixated on, Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh!? That's, um—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, sounds great!
That's part of your "romance" too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Looks like we're bound to butt heads somewhere down the line over which of us gets to wipe that smug look off his face.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...When that time comes... I will...!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Wow!
—Look at that face she's making. Not bad."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy... Tap...—
choice_data_list: What do you think is the reason they work so hard?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"That is because... Rob Roy and the others—
each have—their own reason to run—"

"Yes. Of course, that's the primary premise.
Every Umamusume has her own reason to run.
However—"
"Symboli Kris S likely doesn't realize what it is that stokes an even hotter flame in her reason for running."
choice_data_list: —Because you're 'colder' than anyone else.
—Because you're "colder" than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Is it because I'm... cold...?
Nodding firmly, I began explaining my thoughts to ensure there would be no misunderstandings—
The one and only defining trait—the greatest strength—of the Umamusume known as Symboli Kris S. That is—

Unchanging, immovable. It lies in calmly, reliably, and steadily
stacking up "results" without fuss.
That absolute, almost ruthless determination and relentless stride—that is the true nature of Symboli Kris S's "chill."

This overwhelmingly ruthless "chill" is something
every Umamusume who has faced her
must have experienced—
Any Umamusume who competes with Symboli Kris S inevitably fires up her spirit to overcome that "chill."

And realize—or ignite it.
The reason you run, deep within you—the flame of your soul.

Everyone builds their fire... their "heat,"
knocking on the gates of their limits
to overcome Symboli Kris S's "chill"—
Trying to catch up and surpass Symboli Kris S... burning hot, hotter and hotter without end...!

Yes, Symboli Kris S is already
transforming the Japanese racing world...!

I've seen the proof of that in all our races so far,
and in every day spent with Symboli Kris S...!
That is why I can say with confidence—
Symboli Kris S isâ
choice_data_list: You don't need to carry that "heat."
You don't need to carry that "heat."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: Because that's a strength unique to you...!
Because that's a strength unique to you...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
————Now I see.
...I finally understand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...My 'mission' is—
to achieve a 'revolution'—and yet, that is—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It is not for me...
to become the standard-bearer of the "revolution"—
choice_data_list: —You are going to be the "trial" for everyone else.
—You're going to become everyone's "trial."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: An "ordeal"...—
Because it possesses no heat, it tests everyone's passion; because it is unchanging, it urges everyone to change.
The way Symboli Kris S carries herself creates even greater passion and new transformation in the Umamusume who face her.

And this will become—
each of our "revolutions"—
and eventually, a "revolution" for the entire Japanese racing world!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"What I must do... is become absolute strength itself—
and serve as everyone's... 'ordeal'...—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The bearer of the "revolution"—... the standard-bearer—
A hero yet unseen...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...It never needed to be—me, after all—

Any doubt faded from Symboli Kris S's face,
and as a brand-new resolve shone in her heart,
I felt it as if it were my own...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ......Let's sort through the situation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
As a precondition—
What is required... is absolute proof of the strong.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...The target for that.
...My mark is obvious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn)... The Japan Cup...
The Arima Kinen...—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: In every single one... I will produce "results."
choice_data_list: The Autumn Senior Triple Crown route, huh...!!
The Autumn Senior Triple Crown route...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...Are there any objections?

There's no way. As her Trainer,
I was prepared long ago to strive for
an overwhelming strength beyond anything seen before...!!
choice_data_list: —Let's get so strong people will resent us for it.

text_block_list.text:
To become an absolute, overwhelming "trial"
that makes everyone want to defeat her—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh.
Enough to make them hate you, huh—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...Now, let us begin.
...Once again, our "mission".
choice_data_list: Yeah! We'll bring a "revolution" to the Japanese racing world!
Yeah! A "revolution" for the Japanese racing world!

text_block_list.text:
With a refreshed spirit, she aimed to become an absolute champion,
first setting her sights on the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
